description: tree_size=0 with an RFC 6962 empty-tree root: MTH({}) = SHA-256(). No leaf can sit in a tree of size 0, so the only correct verdict is a refusal. This vector exists because a corpus that leaves the empty-tree constant undefined - or that puts another tree's root in its place - cannot be met by a second implementation.

leaf_entry.definition: SHA-256 of the leaf input bytes, hex-encoded
leaf_entry.leaf_input_ascii: scitt-rfc9162 test vectors v1 :: fail-empty-tree :: leaf 0
